entry.title: Bill 110 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County): Passed Second Reading → Adopted
entry.content:
AMENDS ORDINANCE NO. 25-45, AS AMENDED, THE OPERATING BUDGET OF THE COUNTY OF HAWAIʻI FOR THE FISCAL YEAR ENDING JUNE 30, 2026

Increases revenues in the revenues in the State Grants – Hawaiʻi County Food Access Summit Program account ($40,000) and appropriates the same to the Hawaiʻi County Food Access Summit Program account. Funds will be used to plan and facilitate two Food Access Summits that will be used to collect data, support community collaboration, and showcase successful projects.

Status: Passed Second Reading → Adopted

Latest action: Council: Bill 110 passes second & final reading - 01/23/26
